summary: Quiet residential street lined with parked cars; flats about 20 m away and steep.
reasons: Homes and flats 20 m away, all round

best_section.where: Southern end of Beatrice Street west kerb, just north of the side street

drivers.seclusion: Flats and houses 20-28 m away on the section's own side and across the road; none within 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Public street with kerbside parking on both sides; a van fits in line with other cars.
drivers.traffic: Residential street, moderate traffic, junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked along both kerbs in the imagery; a 2P weekday daytime limit applies near the north end.

flags: Steep: about 6% here, 9.8% mean overall, 15% max
2P sign Mon-Fri 9am-4pm near the north end
sun_shade: Mostly open with street trees across the road shading the east side and some of the afternoon.
